The author employs a diction that is precise and technical, selecting words with specific connotations to enhance the analytical tone of the narrative. This choice of vocabulary contributes to the gravitas of the work, ensuring that the language matches the seriousness of the subject matter. Syntactically, the prose is methodical, with sentences constructed to resemble links in a chain. This structural approach creates a sturdy and cohesive narrative flow, reflecting the logical and analytical nature of the content. The combination of technical diction and methodical syntax results in a style that is both rigorous and authoritative.

The largest country in the world is Russia.
